subject: Re: RetailCo - model regression after v2.1 rollout / next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@retailco.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-25T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: RetailCo discovery recap + model recommendations

Hi Alex — great to meet today. Quick recap from our discovery and recommended next steps so we have alignment:

What we heard
- Primary goal: improve product search relevance and recommended items CTR across web + mobile.
- Current pipeline: in-house ranking model + 3rd-party embedding service for semantic match.
- Key constraints: p99 latency target < 250ms per request, data isolation required, and strict quality SLO (top-10 relevance NDCG drop < 1.5%).

Initial model recommendations
1) Redwood-optim-bert-3B (v2.0): best fit for relevance; low latency with our quantized profile.
2) Redwood-compact-1.1B (v1.5): fallback for cheaper reads / burst capacity.

Next steps (action items)
- I will share the eval prompt set and our benchmark dashboards (link below).
- We’ll run a small A/B on your staging dataset to validate NDCG and latency. Target start: next week.
- If you agree, I’ll open a dedicated project in our console and schedule a handoff with Dylan for setup and Elliot for eval monitoring.

Attachments: retailco_prompt_set_v1.json (prompt/test cases)
Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-retailco-eval

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
Mobile: (415) 555-0123

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@retailco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-26T09:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RetailCo discovery recap + model recommendations

Thanks Marissa — that looks good. A couple quick Qs before we move to A/B:

1) How do you handle model updates/patches? We run weekly model promotions in our infra and need a rollback plan if quality drops.
2) Can you share a concrete example of how you surface regressions (diffs / alerts)?

Also looping in Procurement (procurement@retailco.com) to keep them in the loop on timing.

Alex

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@retailco.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>, Elliot Price <elliot@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-26T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RetailCo discovery recap + model recommendations

Great questions — short answers here and I’ll follow with specifics:

1) Update cadence & rollback: You control pinned model versions per route in the Console. For hosted/dedicated customers we recommend pinning the production route to the last-known-good version (e.g., redwood-optim-bert-3B@v2.0). When we onboard a new version (v2.1), we run canaries and rollouts. If we detect regression by our eval hooks or your custom test set, we can automatically rollback to the pinned version or trigger a manual rollback.

2) Regression detection & diffs: Our eval pipeline computes delta metrics (NDCG, BLEU, exact match, safety scores) and produces a human-readable diff report (attached: eval_diff_report_v2.1_vs_v2.0.pdf). Alerts are surfaced in the Console and can be pushed to Slack/email or a webhook.

I attached the diff report and a short rollback_playbook.md with runbooks. For RetailCo specifically, Dylan can help size the A/B and Elliot will set up the eval dashboards and per-prompt alerts.

Proposed next steps:
- Approve A/B start window: May 3 — May 10 (staging first, then production canary).
- Marissa to provision a dedicated project and invite your SREs.
- Elliot to configure the prompt-based alerting thresholds.

Are you ok with that timeline?

Marissa

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@retailco.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-27T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RetailCo discovery recap + model recommendations

Looping in a quick technical note on rollback and diffs: we instrument both model-level and request-level tracing. If v2.1 shows regression on your prompt set we can do either:

A) Immediate pin: set production route to redwood-optim-bert-3B@v2.0 (instant to config) — no infra change required.
B) Canary rollback: stop traffic to v2.1, re-route canary traffic back to v2.0, then scale down v2.1 instances.

For the diff report we produce two artifacts: 1) per-prompt examples (before/after) so reviewers can see exact answer deltas, 2) aggregate metric deltas with confidence intervals. To validate, we’ll need the staging sample you mentioned (10k queries). Please drop it into the Drive folder or share a signed S3 link.

I’ll prep the runbook steps in rollback_playbook.md (attached) and run a quick internal test on a synthetic regression to validate automation.

Dylan

From: Elliot Price <elliot@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@retailco.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-28T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RetailCo discovery recap + model recommendations

Alex — added the RetailCo prompt set to our eval dashboard and kicked off a baseline run vs v2.0 and v2.1. Initial results (quick summary):

- v2.1 latency: +12ms median vs v2.0 (within SLO).
- Top-10 NDCG delta: v2.1 shows a -2.3% drop vs v2.0 on the RetailCo prompt set (outside your 1.5% threshold).
- Examples: attached in the PDF have three representative regressions where ranking swapped an out-of-context item into top-3.

Recommendation: hold rollout until we investigate root cause. Options: pin to v2.0 for production route, or narrow canary to lower traffic while we debug.

I’ll open a jira ticket linking the per-prompt diffs and tag SREs for deeper trace logs.

Elliot

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@retailco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>, Elliot Price <elliot@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-30T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RetailCo discovery recap + model recommendations

Thanks team — appreciate the quick turn. Let’s pin production to v2.0 while you dig in. Please send a short summary of root cause findings and an ETA for remediation; Procurement is reviewing timelines for the Dedicated pilot and wants to be sure rollback behavior is well-defined.

Alex
Senior Product Manager, RetailCo
alex.johnson@retailco.com

On a process note: Marissa, please include the DocuSign/contract timeline in the next update so Procurement can align on the pilot start date.
